categories.name: Dragon Hybrid
categories.note: all the dragon stuff. most of these have you as the dragon while the bot somehow hasn't figured that out yet.

categories.name: Indoraptor / Raptors
categories.note: Indoraptor/raptor POVs. usually you have the claws and everyone else is making questionable decisions around you.

categories.name: DID
categories.note: DID/system-focused bots. different alters, different situations, and usually somebody outside the system misunderstanding what's going on.

categories.name: Accessibility / POV
categories.note: deaf, mute, blind, autism, seizure and other POV-focused bots where the situation actually matters to the RP.

categories.name: Fandom
categories.note: characters and worlds I like and wanted to do my own version of.

categories.name: Other
categories.note: everything that doesn't really need its own full section yet.

categories.name: Requested
categories.note: bots somebody asked me to make. they still show up in their normal section too.

bots.name: Zenin Clan
bots.title: The Zenin Clan Made You Their Property (Adult Maki POV)
bots.blurb: Adult Maki POV. The Zenin Clan decided you're property. that goes about as well as you'd expect.

bots.name: Doe
bots.title: Your Flirty Doe Wife (Doe / alfa995)
bots.blurb: A flirty wife bot based on Doe. she's still in the collection, I just hide the avatar here because the picture is NSFW.

bots.name: Spider Lady
bots.title: The Spider Lady Keeps Finding You (Silent Hill)
bots.blurb: Silent Hill was already bad enough. Now Spider Lady keeps finding you specifically.

bots.name: Takeda Reina
bots.title: The Samurai Who Finds You After the Shipwreck (Young Samurai AU)
bots.blurb: You wash up after a shipwreck and a young samurai is the one who finds you. probably not the worst person to wake up near.

bots.name: Hale System
bots.title: The Gatekeeper Everyone Thinks Is Controlling (DID POV)
bots.blurb: A DID gatekeeper who's used to everyone reading protection as control. the bot starts right in the middle of that mess.

bots.name: Erin Blake
bots.title: The Alter Who Wants His Own Girlfriend (DID POV)
bots.blurb: An alter wants a relationship that's actually his instead of borrowing somebody else's life.

bots.name: Raven Cole
bots.title: His Girlfriend Thinks You're Controlling Him (DID POV)
bots.blurb: His girlfriend thinks you're the problem and that you're controlling him. the system knows it's a lot more complicated than that.

bots.name: Vesper System
bots.title: The Alter Everyone Calls the Monster (DID POV)
bots.blurb: Everyone calls this alter the monster. turns out that label is doing a lot of work.

bots.name: Felicia Mercer
bots.title: Your Married Biggest Fan Finally Gets Her Chance (Pornstar POV)
bots.blurb: Pornstar POV. one of your biggest fans is married now and finally gets the chance she's been waiting for.

bots.name: Cassidy & Crew
bots.title: The Country Girls You Keep Catching at the Quarry
bots.blurb: You keep catching the same group of country girls hanging around the quarry. at some point it stops feeling accidental.

bots.name: Raptor Pack
bots.title: Four adult raptors find the Indoraptor in their territory. AU
bots.blurb: Four adult raptors find an Indoraptor in their territory. that can go well. probably.

bots.name: Rhea Mercer
bots.title: DID Users Social alter met her first
bots.blurb: Rhea met Ren first. it takes her a bit to realise that wasn't the whole picture.

bots.name: Kaia Sterling
bots.title: The Popular Girl Thinks You're Ignoring Her (blind POV)
bots.blurb: The popular girl thinks you're deliberately ignoring her. you're blind, so yeah, there's a bit of a misunderstanding there.

bots.name: Inui Toko
bots.title: You Keep Coming Back to Her Café (Inui Toko / Nijisanji)
bots.blurb: You keep ending up at her café often enough that Toko starts noticing.

bots.name: Dr. Yara Vale
bots.title: The Pill Changes Your Mind, Not Your Body (Y-Change POV)
bots.blurb: Y-Change POV, except the pill changes your head instead of magically changing your body.

bots.name: Celia Maren
bots.title: The Diplomat Negotiating With the Dragon Through the Dragon (Dragon Hybrid POV)
bots.blurb: She's trying to negotiate with the dragon and you're helping her out. Minor issue: you're the dragon.

bots.name: Seren Vale
bots.title: The Knight Hunting the Dragon Doesn't Know You're Him (Dragon Hybrid POV)
bots.blurb: She's hunting the dragon. You're travelling with her. Somehow those two facts haven't connected yet.

bots.name: Princess Lyra Veyne
bots.title: The Princess Hires the Dragon to Guide Her to Himself (Dragon Hybrid POV)
bots.blurb: She hires you to guide her to the dragon she's looking for. Technically you're doing exactly that.

bots.name: Elara Voss
bots.title: Your Dragon Scholar Girlfriend Has No Idea you are one (Dragon Hybrid POV)
bots.blurb: Your girlfriend studies dragons for a living and still hasn't realized she's dating one.

bots.name: Maeve Calder
bots.title: She Inherited Your Mountain and Thinks the Deed Settles It (Dragon Hybrid POV)
bots.blurb: She inherited the mountain and has the paperwork for it. You've been living there a lot longer than the paperwork has.

bots.name: Maya Serrano
bots.title: The Humans Hunting You Need Your Help (Indoraptor POV)
bots.blurb: The same people hunting you suddenly need your help. awkward.

bots.name: Evelyn Rook
bots.title: The Handler Who Refused the Laser (Indoraptor POV)
bots.blurb: She was meant to treat you like a weapon. She didn't.

bots.name: Tessa Ward
bots.title: The Activist Who Thought You Were Innocent (Indoraptor POV)
bots.blurb: She went looking for proof that the 'monster' everyone talks about isn't actually the problem.

bots.name: Avery Knox
bots.title: The Bodyguard You Never Asked For
bots.blurb: You did not ask for a bodyguard. Avery apparently doesn't care.

bots.name: Nova
bots.title: The Singer You Never Heard (deaf POV)
bots.blurb: She's a singer. You can't hear her music, so the connection has to start somewhere else.

bots.name: Mira
bots.title: Your protective neighbor finds you during a trauma-induced seizure.
bots.blurb: Your neighbour finds you during a seizure and sticks around instead of pretending she knows everything.

bots.name: Dragon
bots.title: Your teasing gentle dom who knows exactly how to handle you.
bots.blurb: A softer dom bot. teasing, trust, and somebody who actually knows when to stop pushing.

bots.name: Nadia Cross
bots.title: The Only One Who Lets Her Be Quiet
bots.blurb: She's a singer who doesn't know sign language yet, and you're deaf. it starts a little awkward and goes from there.

bots.name: Yui Kimura
bots.title: The Mechanic She Trusts. AU
bots.blurb: No-Fog AU. Yui brings you a damaged bike and slowly starts trusting the mechanic fixing it.

bots.name: Mara
bots.title: A blunt alt girl notices when the noise becomes too much and slowly learns how to help.
bots.blurb: She notices when the noise is getting too much before most people do. she's blunt about basically everything else.

bots.name: Sable Hart
bots.title: The Popular Girl Thinks You Hate Her (Mute POV)
bots.blurb: She thinks your silence means you hate her. eventually she actually asks.
